THE COMPLETE DOCTOR ACADEMYMRCPsych Paper A · Domain 2 Neuroscience · 2027 syllabus

Aim and objectives

Aim. To explain the anatomy and function of the basal ganglia, temporal and frontal lobes, white matter and ascending systems for MRCPsych Paper A.

At the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

  1. Describe the direct and indirect basal ganglia pathways and link them to Parkinson's and Huntington's diseases.
  2. Describe the Papez circuit, the roles of the hippocampus and amygdala, and Klüver-Bucy syndrome.
  3. Distinguish dorsolateral, orbitofrontal and medial frontal syndromes, and the role of the anterior cingulate gyrus.
  4. Name association, commissural and projection fibres, such as the arcuate fasciculus and corpus callosum, and their disconnection syndromes.
  5. Name the sources of ascending systems: ventral tegmental area, substantia nigra, locus coeruleus, raphe nuclei and nucleus basalis of Meynert.
  6. Answer the chapter's 89 exam-style questions, scoring at least 80%, by the end of this chapter.
